Taco night
serves 5
1 lb ground beef 93/7
1 packet taco seasoning
2/3 cup water
10 corn tortillas
1 cup shredded lettuce
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
cheese
1/2 cup salsa
cook beef in skillet til browned, drain
add taco seasoning and water, simmer 5 min
warm tortillas, fill with beef, lettuce, cheddar and salsa
